mechanism_claims.claim_text: GmSPID has direct protease-inhibition evidence in the paper-local enzyme panel, with strongest support for trypsin inhibition and weaker or absent support for the other tested proteases.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GmSPID protein in the paper protease activity assay panel
limitations: Protease inhibition is a direct biochemical function assay, but the paper-local evidence does not prove that bacterial killing is mediated through a bacterial protease target.
mechanism_claims.source_review_verification: Checked against packet figure/caption locator and local rendered PDF page; not accepted from DBAASP machine rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GmSPID shows antimicrobial growth or viability phenotype in the tested microorganism panel after incubation, but CFU reduction alone is phenotype evidence rather than a closed molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GmSPID-treated microbial viability or CFU phenotype across the paper-local panel
limitations: CFU/growth outcomes are antimicrobial phenotype evidence and are not promoted to direct mechanism without an accompanying direct assay locator.
mechanism_claims.source_review_verification: Checked source-located figure/caption plus worker-2 handoff boundary; DBAASP fallback rows remained candidate-only.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The packet contains direct membrane-permeability evidence for GmSPID treatment in the E. coli assay, based on leakage of a cytosolic reporter enzyme into the medium.
limitations: The permeability readout is species/condition-specific and should not be generalized to every activity row without separate source evidence.
mechanism_claims.source_review_verification: Checked figure/caption locator and worker-3 quantitative figure-surface inventory; no source passage was copied.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AFM evidence supports GmSPID-associated changes to P. entomophila cell-surface topography and measured surface biophysical parameters after treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GmSPID-treated P. entomophila cell surface by AFM
limitations: AFM directly supports surface alteration under the tested conditions, but it does not identify a single molecular target.
mechanism_claims.source_review_verification: Checked packet figure/caption locator and rendered PDF page for the AFM surface.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM evidence supports GmSPID-associated changes in P. entomophila cell morphology and surface structure after treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GmSPID-treated P. entomophila morphology by SEM
limitations: SEM provides direct morphology evidence but remains structural/phenotypic at the cell-envelope level rather than target-specific chemistry.
mechanism_claims.source_review_verification: Checked packet figure/caption locator and rendered PDF page for the SEM surface.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM evidence supports GmSPID-associated disturbance of P. entomophila cell-envelope or ultrastructural organization after treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GmSPID-treated P. entomophila ultrastructure by TEM
limitations: TEM provides direct ultrastructural evidence but does not by itself resolve the molecular target or distinguish primary from downstream damage.
mechanism_claims.source_review_verification: Checked packet figure/caption locator and rendered PDF page for the TEM surface.
